title: Had gone bad
text: Had gone bad. This potpourri used to be terrific - the best one from Aromatique, in my opinion.  This particular bag had gone "off" and actually smellled rancid, which is a bad thing in a potpourri.  They took it back, no problem.  It's sad though, as I was looking forward to scenting my home with it.
